name: attendance_meeting
description: Invitation to an attendance meeting to agree support (stage: Attendance meeting).
subject: Attendance meeting - {pupil_name}
body: {first_name}'s attendance has not improved enough and we would like to meet you to talk about it and agree how we can support {first_name}.
{first_name}'s attendance from {period} is {attendance_pct}%. {first_name} has missed {sessions_missed} sessions (half-days), {unauthorised} of them unauthorised.
At the meeting we will listen to any barriers to attendance and agree an attendance support plan with actions for school, home and {first_name}. Please let us know if the time does not suit you.

placeholders.pupil_name: The pupil's preferred first name and surname
placeholders.details: Meeting date, the agreed target and any extra note
